development.title: The app is still in development
development.body: Mythgate 5e Companion is actively being developed — some features may change or have rough edges. If something looks broken, letting us know through Support really helps the project.

analytics.title: Share anonymous usage data
analytics.body: We can collect anonymous usage statistics (no email, uid, character names, or note text) to find bugs and improve the app. Allow it?

thanks.title: Thank you!
thanks.body: Thanks for helping the project grow. You can change this choice anytime in Settings.
